source_rect_format: Pillow left, top, right, bottom; right/bottom exclusive
hair_isolation: 16px source side gutters, center-scalp-connected alpha, 2px edge retention

masking.neck: Continuous chin-relative curve starts outside head silhouette and tapers to neck base; no stepped ledges
masking.clothing: Inner collar edge pixels extruded into narrow seam gutters; body behind neck, front collar limited to neck ROI; cropped broad shoulders
masking.hair: Single hair pass before front collar; caps clip crown by actual underside with nearest-supported edge fallback and two-pixel overlap; helmets suppress hair
masking.headset: Bald scalp fits upper band to actual crown; ear pads and microphone remain fixed below row 95
masking.alpha: Soft one-pixel matte choke on solid cutouts; thin glasses/headset edges preserved

art.style: Ace Combat inspired realistic illustrated adults; original generated artwork
art.reference: User-supplied portrait style reference; no game artwork included
